title: Bạn có thể kích hoạt nó cho tôi được không?
englishTitle: Can you activate it for me?
pronunciation: Ban co the kich hoat no cho toi duoc khong
summary: For asking a SIM, eSIM, app, or phone-shop clerk to activate the service for you.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: The purchase is done; the phone still needs the counter to make it work.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Keep the SIM, eSIM QR code, error screen, or setup page visible.

phrases.vietnamese: Bạn có thể kích hoạt nó cho tôi được không?
phrases.english: Can you activate it for me?
phrases.pronunciation: Ban co the kich hoat no cho toi duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Bạn có thể asks can you; kích hoạt means activate; nó cho tôi means it for me; được không? asks if it is possible.

breakdown.vietnamese: Bạn có thể kích hoạt nó cho tôi được không?
breakdown.english: Can you activate it for me?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi password, SIM-card, and data-top-up pages help if activation turns into setup trouble.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at airport SIM counters, phone shops, hotel desks, and mobile-service kiosks.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Activation may need a passport, code, restart, or APN setting. Let staff point to the next screen.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: No-signal, OTP, eSIM, charging, and written-password pages cover problems that can show up after activation.
